subject: EU-only processing confirmation and VPC details — DPIA scope
messages:
-----Message 1-----
From: Sofie Larsen <sofie.larsen@medtechglobal.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@medtechglobal.com
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 09:04:00 +0000
Subject: EU-only processing + VPC options / DPIA scope

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are moving this internally and Legal/Privacy have a few non-negotiable asks before we proceed to procurement:

- Confirmation that all MedTech customer data (PHI-adjacent telemetry and patient identifiers) will be processed and stored in the EU only (we need EU residency by default).
- Copy of your standard DPA and confirmation you will commit to SCCs (controller->processor) or the EU DPA equivalent.
- Whether Redwood can support a customer-managed VPC/private deployment (not just regional tenancy) for our production workload; if so, high-level network/connectivity requirements.
- Evidence: SOC 2 summary report and completed SIG/CAIQ items for technical controls.
- We will need to run a DPIA; please confirm what information you need from us and any artifacts you can provide (data flow diagrams, subprocessors list, retention policies).

Can you confirm these points and share any relevant artifacts? Our timeline is to complete legal review by Nov 28 so appreciate a quick turnaround.

Best,
Sofie Larsen
Head of Privacy, MedTech Global

-----Message 2-----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sofie Larsen <sofie.larsen@medtechglobal.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 13:27:00 +0000
Subject: RE: EU-only processing + VPC options / DPIA scope

Hi Sofie — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below; Connor (Legal) and Laura (Solutions) are looped for specifics and artifacts.

- EU-only processing: Yes. For customers that request EU residency, we can ensure that production inference and storage for customer-specific datasets and artifacts are provisioned in EU regions only. This includes our Hosted EU-only deployment and Private/VPC options.

- DPA/SCCs: We have a standard DPA that includes SCC references; we can provide the PDF and we are open to countersigned SCC execution via DocuSign.

- Customer-managed VPC / Private deployment: We offer Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem) which provides a customer-controlled network boundary. Laura will share the network requirements doc and a short checklist (ports, CIDR, peering/Direct Connect options).

- Evidence: Attached are a SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and our completed SIG questionnaire (sig-questionnaire.xlsx). If you prefer CAIQ output instead, we can provide that too.

- DPIA: We can support you with artifacts (data flow diagram, subprocessors list, retention policy, processor risk assessment template). To scope the DPIA we need: (a) the types of data you will pass to inference (PT/PHI fields and any identifiers), (b) expected volumes and retention periods, and (c) whether model inputs will be logged for quality or retained for <X> purposes.

Next steps: Connor, can you confirm legal language on SCCs and share the DPA + a DocuSign link? Laura, attaching the VPC checklist and proposed timeline for customer-managed deployment would help.

Neha
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Neha/Laura — assigning INF-4523 (legal review for MedTech DPA/SCCs).

Short answers and actions:
- We can execute the EU SCCs (2021/2024 sequence as applicable) on top of our standard DPA. I will prepare a redline for their legal team.
- Attachments: I pulled the SOC 2 summary and our canonical DPA; adding both to a DocuSign packet for signature.
- DPIA artifacts: we have a standard DPIA support pack (data flow diagram template, subprocessors list, retention schedule). I will share an internal link and an exported PDF.

Privacy note: If they are passing PHI or categorised health data, we should confirm whether they need HIPAA-specific terms — we typically advise a Private deployment + isolated VPC for stronger separation and to limit our access surface.

Timeline: I can get the DPA + DocuSign link to Neha by EOD Friday (2025-11-14). For the DPIA pack and SIG/CAIQ exports, target early next week.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

-----Message 4-----

Thanks all — that is exactly what we needed. A few quick notes from Legal/Privacy after initial review:

- Please send the DocuSign DPA and indicate whether you will execute SCC Addendum or include SCC text directly in the DPA.
- For the DPIA, we will send a scoped list of processing activities; please include the subprocessors list and a high-level diagram of where tokens and logs are stored and for how long. If you can declare a default retention for inference logs, that will help our risk assessment.

Action items for Redwood:
1) Send DPA + SCC approach via DocuSign link.
2) Attach SOC 2 summary and completed SIG/CAIQ export (we received the XLSX you sent; Legal will review).
3) Provide VPC checklist and estimated time to provision a Private/VPC deployment in EU (network design + call to coordinate).

We are targeting procurement sign-off by Nov 28, so if you can hit the DocuSign + DPIA artifacts by Nov 21 that would be ideal.

Thanks —
Sofie
Head of Privacy, MedTech Global
